user.title: Pair AC with room thermometer
user.description: Choose a native SwitchBot Cloud AC and a temperature sensor. This creates a local presentation entity; sensor events never control the AC. Export this paired entity to HomeKit and exclude the original AC. A missing sensor makes this entity unavailable instead of displaying a default room temperature.

error.invalid_source: Select a registered native SwitchBot Cloud AC and a Celsius or Fahrenheit temperature sensor.

abort.already_configured: This AC is already paired. Use Configure to change its sensor.

init.title: AC presentation options
init.description: Preserves the AC entity and HomeKit pairing. Saving sends no command. Fixed automatic fan hides fan controls on this paired AC and restores automatic fan when it is operated. Native HA/Dashboard fan controls remain available. Sensor events never control the AC.

data.fixed_auto_fan: Fixed automatic fan on paired AC (hide fan controls)

error.invalid_source: Select a registered temperature sensor with Celsius or Fahrenheit units.
error.auto_fan_unavailable: The native AC does not currently advertise automatic fan. Check the source and connection.
